checks.finding: design.md Architecture and Components define bootstrap routing, provider adapters, shared validation, protected CI and verification interactions. Technology choices include Python stdlib, provider CLIs, GitHub Actions and provider-owned state; Layer Specifications explicitly excludes a graphical frontend.

Architecture's directed flow proceeds from bootstrap through routing, provider skills, validation, prepare, approval, apply, collectors and verification. No component dependency cycle is declared; Cross-Layer Dependencies describes document relationships rather than runtime dependencies.

design.md Data Plan supplies Data Entities, Existing Data Affected and Migration Strategy. It defines versioned cloud artifacts, unchanged legacy dispatch, contained no-overwrite storage, secret exclusion and retention prerequisites.

API / Contract Plan defines versioned request, lock, preview, authorization, observation and verification artifacts. Public Invocation Contract specifies skill names, script command, operations, request/output paths, result and input-error envelopes, exit codes and additive compatibility. External Integration Inventory names supported provider API contracts.

design.md Security Boundaries identifies local-to-CI, CI-to-provider and provider-to-evidence boundaries with authorization, classification and OWASP concerns. security-spec.md refines these with protected environments, scoped OIDC, fixed argument arrays, trusted provenance, redaction and adversarial tests.
SKIP: Feature Type is developer-tooling / cloud orchestration, explicitly a CLI/skill surface rather than fullstack. frontend-spec.md confirms no browser frontend, routes, client state or API client.

Test Strategy and Unit and Integration Boundaries define unit subjects and doubles, subprocess/CI/provider integration boundaries, real compile/synthesis checks, isolated host verification and separately authorized live trials. Four named tests/cloud-orchestration-*.tests.py entry points and task-specific verification addenda provide planned evidence; Documentation and Release Delivery covers TEST-013/014.

Components defines bootstrap routing, both provider skills, shared validation, cloud profiles, governed CI templates and audit inventory. Named detailed-design subsections define routing, execution, collectors and verification; investigation.md establishes the existing evaluator, registry and bootstrap context.
